The shape should connect two or more nodes and each node should be used once only. Moreover, the shape can connect two nodes vertically, horizontally or diagonally, but it should never jump a node.

items.text:
Pattern lock is a common type of screen lock on smartphones. To set a lock pattern, the user draws a shape on a screen consisting of nine nodes. The shape should connect two or more nodes and each node should be used once only. Moreover, the shape can connect two nodes vertically, horizontally or diagonally, but it should never jump a node.
Agatha is a developer for a smartphone brand. A 3 × 3 two-dimensional array pattern is used to represent the screen and store the lock pattern chosen by the user. Each array item represents a node and is defaulted to 0 initially. The value in pattern[imp] indicates that the corresponding node is the nth node in the pattern. If the user chooses the above lock pattern, the following values will be stored in array pattern:
